Name: Gurrabird's Wizard Sprites
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
Wizard sprite replacement for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Revamp Redux[/url] (including beach sprites), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius for SVE[/url]. 

Inspired by VitaleMarino's strikingly-chiseled ponytailed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20595]Wizard portrait[/url], which I highly recommend! Created with appreciation for WerewolfMaster/RR, PaintedParrot/RRforSVE and Jellonip/RRRR for producing such great expansions on the Wizard, sparking endless ideas for his sprite and portrait.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
To ensure these sprites display, you may need to adjust these settings:

[list]
[*][i]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp﻿: [/i]Set "Sprite" to "Use Custom" and set "Use Beach Sprites" to "True".
[*][i]Seasonal character or outfit mods: [/i]Set Wizard and/or Magnus to "False" or uncheck in Generic Mod Config Menu. 
[*][i]Manual replacement method: [/i]If other sprite mods continue to overwrite these, you can directly copy/paste this mod's .png files into the mod folder with the sprites you want to replace. Then rename these sprite files to match the Wizard version you're using: RRRR sprite files are Wizard.png and Wizard_Beach.png; SVE sprite file is Magnus.png; RR and RRforSVE sprite files are NewWizard.png. It's always a good idea to back up the original files first!
[/list]
[b]Issues and feedback:[/b]
This is my first mod, so please let me know if you have any issues or feedback. 

[b]Permissions:[/b]
Please do not reuse or modify any of these assets without checking with me first - as I'm new to this, I'd rather learn to handle my own tweaks/fixes/improvements. 

Please do not re-upload this mod to any other site. If you want to create a translation, please PM me first.
